about: Evaporation and plume source terms per melt-pool operating point (evap.py; melt-pool.md section 5). Upper bound 'flat', best estimate 'wall', lower bound 'boil'. HKL with Raoult activities over the bulk composition: Mg and Zn depletion at the surface is not modelled, so element losses are upper bounds.

keys.tag: case name (alloy, power, speed, plate temperature)
keys.inputs: alloy, P_W, v_m_s, spot_1e2_um, A (absorptivity), T0_K, f_M (Marangoni k factor), f_vol (surface activity of Mg and Zn relative to the bulk: 1, or 0.1 for the depleted-surface 7075 runs)
keys.pool: melt pool from fv3d.py: L/W/D um (liquidus), liquid cross-section mm2, T_peak_flat_K
keys.T_boil_1atm_K: alloy's bubble point at 1 atm (Raoult, with f_vol applied to Mg and Zn)
keys.T_wall_K: depression-wall temperature: 0.54 p_sat = p_amb + 2 sigma / r0
keys.readings: per surface reading (flat / wall / boil): m_dot_kg_s per element and total, loss_ug_per_mm per element and total, vapour_mole_fraction, evap_power_W, area_hot_mm2 (where p_sat > p_amb), loss_fraction_per_pass and shift_per_layer_frac per element (see module docstring)
keys.measured: per element: loss fraction measured in LPBF builds (source), and the mass rate it implies at this case's scan rate, m_dot = f w rho h t v (kg/s) and per mm of track (ug/mm): use these for Mg and Zn. The fractions come from builds at other parameters and are applied unchanged at every power and speed
keys.best: the recommended source: per element the measured rate where one exists (Mg, Zn), else the wall reading; m_dot_kg_s, loss_ug_per_mm, g_per_hour_lasing (per hour of beam-on time), vapour_mole_fraction
keys.exit: Knight jump at the hottest point of each reading: T_surface_K, p_sat_Pa, recoil_Pa (0.54 p_sat), mach, T_vapour_K, u_m_s, rho_vapour_kg_m3, M_vapour_g_mol, Q_vapour_m3_s (volume flow at the exit state, total)

Mg.source: Velikajne et al. 2026, https://doi.org/10.3390/ma19050970 (~0.3 of 2.5 wt%; Li 2024 gives 19 %)

Zn.source: Velikajne et al. 2026 (~1 of 5.6 wt%; Li 2024 gives 3 %, others ~30 %)
